data.topic: What should Product Owner's Flow Mode adopt from the strongest public FigJam diagram skills? Flow Mode turns screenshots, Figma flows and product docs into a checked Mermaid model and writes it to FigJam through the hosted Figma MCP generate_diagram tool, with figma-ds-cli fj as the Desktop fallback. Its sources: AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/references/flow-mode.md, AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/assets/flow-templates.md, AI Systems/Product Owner/sk-product-owner/scripts/flow_check.py, AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/knowledge/Product Owner - Templates - Flow Mode.md, AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/knowledge/Product Owner - Assets - Flow Templates.md and the Flow Mode Delivery section of AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/Custom Instructions.md. The corpus is eight public repos pinned under specs/z-staging-po-009-research/corpus/: figma__mcp-server-guide (Figma's official figma-generate-diagram and figma-use-figjam skills and their references), IamTheLime__dotfiles (figjam-diagrams), southleft__figma-console-mcp-skills (figjam-create-content), mkaralevich__pi-figma-labor (figjam-create), amo-tech-ai__rocket-path-ai (figjam-diagrams), atezer__FMCP (figjam-diagram-builder), ompug__diagram-codebase and memi-design__mermaid-jam. Compare rules, checks, write routes, read-back and verification, failure and retry handling, file and page handling, layout, colour, shapes, density, label rules, iteration and fileKey reuse, hybrid generate_diagram plus use_figma extension, and delivery. Give an adopt or reject verdict, with reasons, on four known gaps: FigJam files have one implicit page and figma.createPage throws, so Flow Mode's new-page rule and page rollback; emojis in Mermaid; reserved node IDs end, subgraph and graph; underscores in node IDs. Also judge Flow Mode's deliberate limits against the corpus: top-to-bottom only, 9 nodes, 3 exits per decision, one accent colour, four shapes.
